Installation and environments

Source: vignettes/articles/installation.Rmd
installation.Rmd

This page lists what TSDFGS needs, the versions we tested, and four ways to get a working setup. Pick the one that fits your computer; the results are the same in all of them.

Requirements

Item Needed Notes
R 4.0 or later Tested with R-devel, release, and oldrel on every push.
C++ compiler C++17 GCC or Clang on Linux and macOS, Rtools on Windows. The package is compiled when you install it.
Rcpp, RcppEigen Installed before TSDFGS R installs them for you from CRAN. They are used at build time.
stats Part of R
ggplot2 Optional Only for the figures of SSDFGS().
OpenMP Optional Used by the parallel options multi.threads and threads. Linux and Windows have it. The default macOS compiler does not, so there the package runs on one thread and returns the same values.

TSDFGS uses one thread unless you ask for more. The environment variable OMP_NUM_THREADS limits the number of threads that multi.threads = TRUE may use.

Versions we tested

Software Version
R 4.4.3
Rcpp 1.1.2
RcppEigen 0.3.4.0.2
GCC 16.2.0

These versions are pinned in environment.yml and are the ones inside the Docker image. GitHub Actions also checks every push on Linux (R-devel, release, oldrel), macOS, and Windows.

Check what you have installed:

packageVersion("TSDFGS")
sessionInfo()   # R, platform, and loaded package versions; add to bug reports

1. Install in R 

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("oumarkme/TSDFGS")          # current main branch
remotes::install_github("oumarkme/TSDFGS@v3.0.0")   # a given release

# Source package attached to each GitHub release
install.packages("https://github.com/oumarkme/TSDFGS/releases/download/v3.0.0/TSDFGS_3.0.0.tar.gz",
                 repos = NULL)

# CRAN, once version 3 is accepted there
install.packages("TSDFGS")

On Windows install Rtools first. On macOS install the command line tools with xcode-select --install.

2. Docker

The image has R, the compilers, and TSDFGS installed. It is built from this repository by GitHub Actions and tested before it is published.

docker pull ghcr.io/oumarkme/tsdfgs:latest      # current main branch
docker pull ghcr.io/oumarkme/tsdfgs:3.0.0       # a release

# Interactive R in the current directory
docker run --rm -it -v "$PWD":/work ghcr.io/oumarkme/tsdfgs:latest R

# Run a script
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work ghcr.io/oumarkme/tsdfgs:latest Rscript my_analysis.R

The files of the current directory appear in /work inside the container. Use a release tag in your own analyses, because latest moves. To build the image yourself, run docker build -f env/Dockerfile -t tsdfgs . in a clone of the repository.

3. conda or mamba

A small environment with R, the compiler, and the packages TSDFGS needs, then TSDFGS from GitHub:

mamba create -n tsdfgs -c conda-forge r-base=4.4 r-rcpp r-rcppeigen r-ggplot2 r-remotes gxx_linux-64 make
mamba activate tsdfgs
Rscript -e 'remotes::install_github("oumarkme/TSDFGS@v3.0.0")'

The gxx_linux-64 compiler is for Linux. On macOS use clangxx_osx-64 (Intel) or clangxx_osx-arm64 (Apple silicon) instead.

To get exactly the versions in the table above, clone the repository and use the pinned file. It also contains the tools to develop and test the package (devtools, roxygen2, pkgdown, testthat):

git clone https://github.com/oumarkme/TSDFGS.git
cd TSDFGS
mamba env create -f environment.yml
mamba activate TSDFGS
R CMD INSTALL .

4. Apptainer or Singularity

On a shared server without Docker, use the same image:

apptainer exec --bind "$PWD":/work --pwd /work docker://ghcr.io/oumarkme/tsdfgs:3.0.0 Rscript my_analysis.R

The repository also has a recipe, env/TSDFGS.def, and a script, env/build_sif.sh, that build the image from the pinned conda file.

Older versions

Version Where Use it for
1.0 CRAN archive The package used in the manuscript (Ou & Liao, 2019).
2.4.2 remotes::install_github("oumarkme/TSDFGS@v2.4.2") The last version before the C++ rewrite.
3.0.0 This page Current version.

To get the training sets of version 2.4.2 with version 3, set options(TSDFGS.legacy_float = TRUE) and use the same seed. Moving from v2 to v3 explains the differences.
